title: Among all female superheroes with blue eyes, what percentage have a strengt
question: Among all female superheroes with blue eyes, what percentage have a strength attribute value greater than 80? Also, return the count of such superheroes published by DC Comics.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_018
    FROM superhero AS s
    INNER JOIN gender AS g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND c.XCL_006 = 'Blue'
),
with_strength AS (
    SELECT b.XCL_018, ha.XCL_011
    FROM base AS b
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON b.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN ws.XCL_011 > 80 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ws.XCL_018) AS percentage,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.XCL_015 = 'DC Comics' AND ws.XCL_011 > 80 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS count_dc
FROM with_strength AS ws
INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON ws.XCL_018 = p.XCL_014

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_018
    FROM superhero AS s
    INNER JOIN gender AS g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND c.XCL_006 = 'Blue'
),
with_strength AS (
    SELECT b.XCL_018, ha.XCL_011
    FROM base AS b
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON b.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN ws.XCL_011 > 80 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ws.XCL_018) AS percentage,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.XCL_015 = 'DC Comics' AND ws.XCL_011 > 80 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS count_dc
FROM with_strength AS ws
INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON ws.XCL_018 = p.XCL_014

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_018
    FROM superhero AS s
    INNER JOIN gender AS g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND c.XCL_006 = 'Blue'
),
with_strength AS (
    SELECT b.XCL_018, ha.XCL_011
    FROM base AS b
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON b.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN ws.XCL_011 > 80 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ws.XCL_018) AS percentage,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.XCL_015 = 'DC Comics' AND ws.XCL_011 > 80 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS count_dc
FROM with_strength AS ws
INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON ws.XCL_018 = p.XCL_014

scope_review.reason: The submitted SQL is semantically correct: it filters female superheroes with blue eyes (superhero.XCL_022 -> colour), restricts to those with a Strength attribute, computes the percentage with strength > 80, and counts those published by DC Comics with strength > 80. The zero result is due to the physical data (no female blue-eyed superheroes have strength > 80 in this dataset), not a logical error. The join to publisher is 1:1 (superhero.XCL_026 -> publisher.XCL_014), so no row multiplication occurs.
checks: Eligibility: gender.XCL_008 = 'Female' and colour.XCL_006 = 'Blue' via superhero.XCL_022 (eye colour) are correctly applied in the base CTE.
Strength filter: attribute.XCL_004 = 'Strength' correctly restricts hero_attribute rows to the Strength attribute.

Percentage denominator: COUNT(ws.XCL_018) counts all female blue-eyed superheroes who have a Strength attribute record, which is the correct population for 'among all female superheroes with blue eyes, what percentage have strength > 80'.
DC Comics count: COUNT(CASE WHEN p.XCL_015 = 'DC Comics' AND ws.XCL_011 > 80 ...) correctly counts superheroes meeting all criteria including DC Comics publisher.

Grain: hero_attribute is joined on superhero.XCL_018 = hero_attribute.XCL_009 with attribute filter, yielding one row per superhero per Strength attribute (1:1 in practice). Publisher join is 1:1. No multiplicity issues.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN ha.XCL_011 > 80 THEN s.XCL_018 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(s.XCL_018) AS percentage_strength_gt_80,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.XCL_015 = 'DC Comics' THEN s.XCL_018 ELSE NULL END) AS count_dc_comics
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
INNER JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_024 = c.XCL_005
INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
  AND c.XCL_006 = 'Blue'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
